lines.text: Did you know? Vis is Latin for see.
Quick quiz! Which means far plus see?

words.ex: She supervises a team of twelve sales staff.
We don't watch much television at home.

publish.title: Vis root: supervise and television
publish.value: Vis comes from Latin "videre" (to see). Words: supervise and television. supervise = super + vis; television = tele + vis.
